newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close higher on active buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close higher on active buying.

text.p: Active buying almost across the board by both foreign and local investors on Tuesday pushed Jakarta shares prices higher, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index rose 6.41 points, or 0.98 percent, to close at 660.37 points. Gainers led losers by 69 to 49, with 56 counters unchanged. Total volume was 154.2 million shares on a turnover of 347.5 billion rupiah.
"Fresh overseas buying might continue on Wednesday with well-spread interest and this will boost overall market sentiment," a broker with Hongkong-based securities firm said.
Brokers said some profit taking might also occur on Wednesday in certain counters and limit any rise in the index.
"Despite the prospect of some profit taking, the market is likely to be able to maintain the index in the positive area on fresh and speculative buying tomorrow," a local broker said.
Brokers said the listing of Bank Pikko on Wednesday could also give some spice to the market.
Fundamentally-sound stocks, including cement maker Semen Gresik as well as cigarette producers Sampoerna and Gudang Garam were favoured by foreign buyers, brokers said.
Semen Gresik rose 250 rupiah to 8,150 rupiah on 1.1 million shares on what brokers said was due to its good fundamentals coupled with a report of increased sales in 1996.
On Tuesday, the company said it had posted consolidated sales of 9.54 million tonnes of cement in 1996, an increase of 11.7 percent against sales of 8.53 million tonnes the previous year.
Cigarette maker Sampoerna rose 250 rupiah to 13,200 rupiah on 1.1 million shares, while Gudang Garam rose 7.24 percent, or 800 rupiah, to 11,850 rupiah with only 183,000 shares traded.
Secondary Prapatan Hotel topped the active list with 9.3 million shares changing hands, rising 275 rupiah, or 15.49 percent to 2,050 rupiah on talk of possible acquisitions, brokers said.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Transportation firm Steady Safe was also actively traded due to recent positive business developments, brokers said. It rose 125 rupiah to 3,275 rupiah on 924,500 shares.

"We heard Steady Safe will launch two passengers ferries this month. I think it boosted market sentiment toward the stock on the expectation that this will help the company's revenue," one broker with foreign firm said.
Heavyweight Telkom fell 50 rupiah to 4,225 rupiah on six million shares after profit taking following recent increases, brokers said.
